author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

Grown in Tengchong’s rich volcanic soil, these fresh lily bulbs are big and plump, with thick, tender layers and a delicate natural sweetness. A little simple cooking is all it takes to bring out their flavor. Simmered in broth, lightly stir-fried, or paired with meat, they make every dish delicious in its own way… The lily bulbs were wonderful, but I do have one regret—we didn’t bring Grandpa along! We’ll be hearing about that for a while!
